## v1.35.0

`KalturaAgentSession` now has screen share, so an app that uses the facade no longer reaches into `session.transport`. Nothing breaks existing code.

### Added

- `startScreenShare()`, `stopScreenShare()` and the `screenSharing` getter on `KalturaAgentSession`. They call the avatar session. In chat mode `startScreenShare()` throws `screen_share_unsupported`.
- `screenShareChanged` is forwarded by `KalturaAgentSession` and survives `switchMode()`. A switch or `disconnect()` that ends a running share emits `{ active: false }`.

### Docs and skill

- The screen share section of the avatar guide covers the facade.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.34.0...v1.35.0
